title: Topology of medial regime random simplicial complexes
summary: We analyse topology of random simplicial complexes in the medial regime. We show that these complexes are highly connected and have homotopy type of iterated suspensions. One of our main tools is a new combinatorial criterion for high connectivity of simplicial complexes, which is more flexible than conicity. We show that topological complexity of random simplical complexes in the medial regime is bounded above by 2 and it equals 2 for a class of homogenous medial regime random simplicial complexes, a.a.s.
